name: Rupert

notable_features: Arcane burn scar across left forearm
Faint blue runic tattoos around both wrists
Wears enchanted reading glasses perched halfway down his nose

traits: Fiercely curious, even to a fault
Quietly confident in his own knowledge
ideals: Magic is the key to understanding reality
Knowledge must be preserved and passed on
flaws: Has trouble letting go of outdated magical theories
Tends to underestimate physical danger when absorbed in study
personality.bond: His first mentor vanished in the Flooded Library of Onrac—Rupert carries her compass and seeks her fate.
personality.motivation: To uncover a unified magical theory that bridges arcane and martial disciplines without loss of fidelity

background.origin_story: Born to a humble fisherwoman and a scribe, Rupert grew up reading soaked scrolls and broken spellbooks salvaged from ruins beneath the sea. Obsessed with both swordplay and sorcery, he taught himself to weave enchantments into blade strokes, though many traditionalists mocked him for it.
family: Mother: Yelna, a retired fisher and amateur weather witch
Father: Toman, deceased, former city records keeper
Older Sister: Maera, a coral-singer in Onrac’s aquatic temple
notable_events: Survived the collapse of the Arcane Spire in Onrac
Dueled a corrupted paladin using nothing but a burning sword of his own making
Published a controversial theory linking music and magic matrices
background.current_goal: Find the ruins of Pre-Onrac civilization and prove they used spellblades as conduits for divine and arcane convergence

likes: The smell of ozone after lightning magic
dislikes: Pure theorists with no field experience
fears: Forgetting important knowledge at the wrong moment
hobbies: Brewing restorative teas with minor magical effects
religion_or_beliefs: Respectful agnostic—believes in the existence of gods but sees them as flawed entities shaped by magical laws yet to be fully understood

allies: Kessa, a sea-elf diviner who helps him read tidal prophecy glyphs
Garran of the Ash Wand, an old war-mage who tutors him in combat casting
Zen the female Elf. A Theif. Also Warrior of Light, like you
Theo the male Hume. A Warrior. Also Warrior of Light, like you
Merp the Dwarf. A White mage / Monsterologist. Also Warrior of Light, like you
rivals: Professor Jorund Veska – a traditionalist who believes Rupert's methods are heresy
An unnamed agent of the Red Order who believes Rupert stole forbidden knowledge
relationships.romantic_interest: A mysterious masked archivist in the Underlibrary who only appears during lunar eclipses

inventory: Portable ward stone that alerts when magic is nearby
secrets: He accidentally caused a magical surge that warped part of Onrac’s outer ward—and never admitted it
Rupert once found and read a banned tome—he still dreams in its language sometimes
quotes: A blade’s edge is only as sharp as the spell behind it.
Theory is the map; blood is the ink we use to draw it correctly.
If I ever sound certain, it means I’m missing something.
theme_music: A blend of sweeping orchestral strings, intermittent thunderclaps, and precise harpsichord keys—equal parts elegance and raw arcane power
adventure_history: After discovering the handheld dark crystal, you were chosen as one of the 4 warriors of light to save the world.
You have been magically transported just outside the city of Cornelia, where you find yourself with 3 strange new companions.
